exposure.needed: whether an issuer's linked Secret is updated at runtime, since that update event is what triggers the affected retry/back-off path

consequence.statement: After upgrading, an issuer whose linked Secret is updated is retried more quickly instead of waiting out the previous high back-off timeout; nothing fails and the configuration is unchanged, only the retry timing differs.
consequence.remediation: No operator action required; optionally verify that issuers reconcile promptly after their linked Secret is updated.

assertion.statement: In cert-manager 1.17.0 the issuer now retries more quickly when its linked Secret is updated, fixing an issue that previously caused a high back-off timeout.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence describes only the issuer controller's internal retry/back-off timing when its linked Secret is updated; it names no field, Helm value, flag, gate, endpoint, protocol surface, or other identity that maps to a supported subject family.
